title: URL shortener
description: The canonical read-heavy path. Almost every request is a redirect that only reads, so a cache in front of the database decides how much load the database ever sees, and the service pool decides how much concurrency there is to go around.
goal: Raise rateRps toward 500 and watch p99 pull away from the mean long before anything is dropped — that gap is the queue forming. Then put the cache hit ratio back down to 0.2 and run it again: the database stops being an afterthought and becomes the bottleneck, without a single parameter of the database itself changing.
